name: Chicken curry with rice

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then cook it in 600 ml lightly salted water with a lid on.
Chop the onion, garlic and ginger finely. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the chicken on all sides. Lift it out.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger in the same pan until soft, then stir in curry powder and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, return the chicken and simmer without a lid.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt.
Divide rice and curry between 4 containers and let cool before closing the lids.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer. Reheat 2–3 minutes in the microwave with a splash of water over the rice.

name: Chili con carne with rice

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml lightly salted water with a lid on.
Chop onion, garlic and bell pepper.
Brown the mince in the oil over high heat, breaking it up.
Add onion, garlic and pepper and fry until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, paprika and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and the drained beans. Simmer, stirring now and then.
Season with salt, then portion with the rice and let cool.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer — chili gets better on day two.

name: Frikadeller with potatoes & carrots

steps.text: Grate the onion finely and mix it with the mince, egg, flour, milk, salt and pepper into a soft farce.
Let the farce rest in the fridge so it firms up.
Scrub the potatoes and boil them in salted water until tender.
Cut the carrots into sticks and boil them until just tender.
Shape 12 frikadeller with a wet spoon and fry them in butter and oil on medium heat, turning a few times.
Portion frikadeller, potatoes and carrots and let cool.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Frikadeller freeze well for 2 months; reheat in a pan or microwave.

name: Pasta bolognese

steps.text: Chop onion, carrot and garlic finely.
Brown the mince in the olive oil over high heat.
Add the vegetables and fry until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and oregano. Simmer gently.
Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Mix pasta and sauce, season with salt and portion with grated parmesan on top.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge; the sauce alone freezes for 3 months.

name: Teriyaki salmon bowls

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Place the salmon on a tray, brush with oil and half the teriyaki sauce.
Bake the salmon until it flakes easily.
Steam or boil the broccoli florets until bright green.
Slice the cucumber and spring onion.
Build bowls of rice, salmon, broccoli and cucumber; drizzle the rest of the sauce and top with spring onion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Eat cold or reheat gently — keep the cucumber separate if you reheat.

name: Red lentil dal

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry chopped onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft.
Add curry powder and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 400 ml water. Simmer until the lentils fall apart, stirring often.
Stir in the spinach, season with salt and portion with the rice.

storageTip: Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer. Add a splash of water when reheating.

name: Chicken burrito bowls

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Slice the chicken thinly and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Fry the chicken in the oil until cooked through.
Fry the sliced pepper in the same pan.
Warm the drained beans and corn.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, pepper, beans and corn; add salsa and a squeeze of lime.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Add the salsa just before eating to keep things crisp.

name: Chicken shawarma with bulgur

steps.text: Mix olive oil, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, salt, 2 grated garlic cloves and half the lemon juice. Coat the chicken.
Let the chicken marinate while the oven heats to 220 °C.
Roast the chicken on a tray until charred at the edges.
Pour 500 ml boiling water over the bulgur, cover and leave to soak.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix with yogurt, the last garlic clove and a pinch of salt.
Slice the chicken and red onion and portion with bulgur and the garlic yogurt.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Store the yogurt sauce in a separate small pot.

name: Overnight oats jars

steps.text: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, honey and cinnamon together in a bowl.
Divide the mixture between 5 jars.
Slice the bananas and add them on top with the frozen berries.
Close the jars and leave them in the fridge overnight — the berries thaw into the oats.

storageTip: Keeps 5 days in the fridge. Eat cold straight from the jar.

name: Pork & veg stir-fry with noodles

steps.text: Boil the noodles, then rinse them in cold water.
Slice the pork thinly. Mix soy sauce, honey, grated garlic and ginger.
Stir-fry the pork in hot oil until browned. Lift it out.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables on high heat.
Add the pork, noodles and sauce and toss until glossy.
Portion and top with sliced spring onion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat in a hot pan or the microwave.

name: Vegetable lasagne

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Chop onion, garlic, courgette and mushrooms.
Fry the vegetables in olive oil until they lose their water.
Add tomatoes, oregano and salt; simmer, then stir in the spinach.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk a little at a time. Simmer to a smooth white sauce.
Layer sauce, sheets and white sauce three times in a dish; finish with cheese.
Bake until golden and bubbling.
Let it rest before cutting into portions.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer, in portions.

name: Thai green curry chicken

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry the curry paste in the oil until fragrant.
Add the chicken in pieces and coat it in the paste.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer.
Add sliced pepper and broccoli florets and cook until just tender.
Season with lime juice and soy sauce, top with coriander and portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer.

name: Meatballs in tomato sauce with pasta

steps.text: Mix mince, egg, oats, half the onion (grated), salt and pepper. Roll about 20 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in olive oil. Lift them out.
Fry the rest of the onion and the garlic, then add tomatoes and oregano.
Return the meatballs and simmer in the sauce.
Boil the pasta until al dente.
Portion pasta, meatballs and sauce with parmesan.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge; meatballs in sauce freeze for 3 months.

name: Chicken & sweet potato traybake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Cube the sweet potato and cut the onions into wedges.
Toss them with oil, paprika and salt on a tray and roast.
Add the chicken thighs, season and roast.
Add the broccoli florets and roast until the chicken is cooked through.
Squeeze lemon over everything and portion.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Reheat in the oven or microwave.

name: Tuna pasta salad

steps.text: Boil the pasta until al dente, then rinse it in cold water.
Dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and chop the red onion finely.
Stir yogurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Mix pasta, drained tuna, corn, vegetables and dressing, then portion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Eat cold.

name: Classic beef lasagne

steps.text: Chop onion, carrot and garlic. Brown the mince in olive oil, then add the vegetables.
Add tomato paste, tomatoes, oregano and salt and simmer the meat sauce until thick.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Melt butter, whisk in flour, then the milk bit by bit and simmer to a béchamel.
Layer meat sauce, sheets and béchamel three times; finish with béchamel and cheese.
Bake until golden.
Rest before cutting into portions.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer, in portions.

name: Butter chicken

steps.text: Mix the chicken pieces with yogurt, half the garam masala and salt.
Let the chicken marinate.
Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry the chicken in half the butter until browned. Lift it out.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger in the rest of the butter.
Add tomato paste, tomatoes and the remaining garam masala; simmer.
Stir in the cream, return the chicken and simmer until cooked through. Portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer.

name: Chickpea & spinach curry

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry chopped onion and garlic in the oil until soft, then add the curry powder.
Add drained chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season and portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer.

name: Cod with potatoes, peas & lemon

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Put the cod in a dish with knobs of butter, lemon slices, salt and pepper.
Bake the cod until it just flakes.
Cook the peas briefly in boiling water.
Portion cod, potatoes and peas and spoon the lemony butter over.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat gently so the fish stays moist.

name: Pork tenderloin in mushroom cream sauce

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Heat the oven to 180 °C. Season the tenderloin and brown it all over in butter.
Finish the tenderloin in the oven.
Fry sliced mushrooms and onion in the same pan.
Add cream and the stock cube and simmer into a sauce.
Rest the meat, slice it and portion with potatoes and sauce.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat gently with the sauce.

name: Hakkebøf with onions & potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Slice the onions and fry them slowly in half the butter until golden.
Shape 4 patties, season and fry them in the rest of the butter, turning once.
Whisk flour into the pan juices, add 300 ml water and the stock cube and simmer into gravy.
Portion patties, onions, potatoes and gravy with cucumber slices.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Patties freeze well for 2 months.

name: Brændende kærlighed (bacon & mash)

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft.
Fry the diced bacon until crisp. Lift it out.
Fry the sliced onions in the bacon fat until golden.
Boil the carrot sticks until tender.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter, salt and pepper.
Portion the mash topped with bacon and onions, with carrots on the side.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Add a splash of milk when reheating the mash.

name: Egg fried rice with veg

steps.text: Cook the rice in 800 ml water with a lid on.
Spread the rice on a tray to cool and dry out.
Stir-fry diced carrot, peas and garlic in hot oil.
Push the veg aside, scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the rice and soy sauce and fry on high heat until it sizzles.
Top with spring onion and portion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.

name: Peanut chicken noodles

steps.text: Boil the noodles, then rinse in cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, grated garlic and 100 ml hot water into a sauce.
Fry the sliced chicken in the oil until cooked through.
Add the frozen vegetables and stir-fry.
Toss in noodles and peanut sauce and portion.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Loosen with a little water when reheating.

name: Chicken fajita wraps

steps.text: Slice chicken, peppers and onion into strips; toss the chicken with the taco seasoning.
Fry the chicken in hot oil.
Add peppers and onion and fry until soft at the edges.
Pack the filling in containers with yogurt and cheese on the side.
When eating: warm the tortillas and fill them.

storageTip: Filling keeps 4 days in the fridge. Store tortillas separately so they don't go soggy.

name: Black bean & sweet potato chili

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry chopped onion and garlic in the oil, then add the spices.
Add diced sweet potato, tomatoes and 200 ml water and simmer.
Add both kinds of beans and simmer until the sweet potato is soft.
Season and portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer.

name: Shakshuka with feta

steps.text: Fry sliced onion and peppers in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin and paprika, then the tomatoes. Simmer until thick.
Make 8 hollows and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble feta over and divide between containers.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat gently; the yolks will firm up.

name: Greek lemon chicken with rice & tzatziki

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, 2 grated garlic cloves, oregano and salt.
Heat the oven to 220 °C and roast the chicken.
Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Make tzatziki: grated cucumber squeezed dry, yogurt, the last garlic clove and a pinch of salt.
Portion chicken, rice, halved tomatoes and feta, with tzatziki on the side.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Keep the tzatziki in a separate pot.

name: Beef goulash with potatoes

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in the oil.
Add the chopped onions and fry until soft.
Stir in paprika and tomato paste, then 750 ml water and the stock cube.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Add diced pepper and potatoes and simmer until the potatoes are done.
Season and portion.

storageTip: Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer.

name: Creamy salmon & broccoli pasta

steps.text: Boil the pasta; add the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the salmon in cubes in olive oil until just cooked.
Add garlic, cream, lemon zest and juice and simmer briefly.
Toss with the drained pasta and broccoli, season and portion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat with a splash of water.

name: Prawn & veg coconut curry

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Fry the curry paste in the oil until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, courgette and pepper and simmer.
Add the thawed prawns and simmer until pink.
Season with lime and soy sauce and portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Don't freeze — the prawns go rubbery.

name: Spinach & feta egg muffins

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin.
Chop spinach and onion, quarter the tomatoes and crumble the feta into the holes.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over the filling.
Bake until set and lightly golden.
Cool on a rack and pack 2–3 muffins per container.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer. Eat cold or warm 30 seconds.

name: Mushroom risotto

steps.text: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1.2 l hot water and keep it warm.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in olive oil until golden. Lift half out.
Add onion and garlic and fry until soft.
Add the rice and toast it, stirring.
Add the stock one ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed, until the rice is creamy but al dente.
Stir in butter, parmesan and the reserved mushrooms; rest with a lid on, then portion.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat with a little water and stir well.

name: Chicken noodle soup

steps.text: Fry sliced ginger and garlic in the oil in a large pot.
Add 2 l water and the stock cubes and bring to the boil.
Poach the whole chicken breasts in the broth, then lift them out and shred.
Add sliced carrots and simmer.
Add the noodles and cook until soft.
Return the chicken, season with soy sauce and top with spring onion.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. The noodles soak up broth — add water when reheating.

name: Stuffed peppers with mince & rice

steps.text: Cook the rice in 300 ml water with a lid on.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Halve the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Brown the mince with chopped onion in olive oil.
Stir in tomatoes, oregano, salt and the rice.
Fill the pepper halves, cover with foil and bake.
Uncover, sprinkle with cheese and bake until golden.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave.

name: Cashew chicken

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600 ml water with a lid on.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan until golden. Set aside.
Toss the chicken pieces in flour and stir-fry them in hot oil.
Add pepper and onion and stir-fry.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey and 4 tbsp water; toss until glossy.
Stir in the cashews and portion with rice.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Keep the cashews separate if you like them crunchy.

name: Chicken pasta bake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Boil the pasta 2 minutes short of al dente.
Fry the diced chicken in olive oil until browned.
Add garlic, tomatoes, cream and oregano and simmer.
Stir in spinach and the drained pasta, tip into a dish and tear mozzarella over.
Bake until bubbling and golden.
Portion once slightly cooled.

storageTip: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer.

name: Fiskefrikadeller with potato salad

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, then let them cool.
Chop the cod finely (or blitz it) with the onion, egg, flour, milk, salt and pepper.
Rest the fish farce in the fridge so it holds together.
Fry spoonfuls of farce in butter on medium heat until golden on both sides.
Slice the potatoes and mix with yogurt, chopped red onion, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Portion fishcakes with potato salad and a lemon wedge.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Eat the fishcakes cold or warm them in a pan.

name: Pasta carbonara

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water; save a cup of the water.
Fry the diced bacon until crisp.
Whisk eggs, grated parmesan and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss pasta with bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until silky.
Portion straight away.

storageTip: Best within 2 days in the fridge. Reheat gently with a splash of water so the egg doesn't scramble.

name: Breakfast burritos

steps.text: Fry the diced pepper in the oil.
Add the drained beans and warm them through.
Whisk and scramble the eggs softly with salt.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans, cheese and salsa and roll them up tightly.
Wrap each burrito in foil or baking paper. Slice avocado fresh when eating.

storageTip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer. Reheat wrapped in a dry pan or the microwave.

name: Slow-cooked beef barbacoa tacos

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 °C. Rub the beef with cumin, paprika, chili, salt and crushed garlic.
Brown the beef in olive oil in an ovenproof pot.
Add tomato paste, the juice of one lime, the stock cube and 400 ml water. Cover and braise in the oven.
Meanwhile slice the red onion thinly and pickle it in the juice of the other lime with a pinch of salt.
Shred the beef with two forks into its juices.
Pack beef, pickled onion and salsa; assemble with warm tortillas, avocado and coriander when eating.

storageTip: Beef keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer. Keep tortillas and avocado separate.
